_note: blurb: the line shown in the Brood Hall. Destroyed defenses rebuild with rebuildChance after battle (see formulas.json). shield: its guard soaks shots aimed at the other defenses first. chokepoint: a structure, not in the fight; for its first `rounds` rounds only `sharePct`% of the attackers fight. Design: docs/06-defense.md.

soil_wall.name: Soil Wall
soil_wall.blurb: One per colony. Its huge guard soaks up blows aimed at your other defenses, round after round.

pit_trap.name: Pit Trap
pit_trap.blurb: An antlion-style pit: cheap, Foliage only, and small ants that rush in tumble down it. Deadly to Minor Soldiers and Workers.

acid_sentry.name: Acid Sentry
acid_sentry.blurb: Formic acid emplacement. Strong, and dangerous to Major Soldiers.

narrow_tunnel.name: Narrow Tunnel
narrow_tunnel.blurb: One per colony. Raiders squeeze in a few at a time: in the first round only half of them can fight. It is never destroyed.
